theorems.name: Step_pure_is_wf
theorems.notes:
This cannot be proved as generated. The only case that fails is `vshiftop`; the other 53 constructors are proved.

CAUSE: in the regenerated `Step_pure.vshiftop` (SP/baseline/wasm2.0.lean.orig), the premise `(List.length var_0_lst) = (List.length c'_lst)` that the OLD model had is gone. The model's `Forall₂ P xs ys` is `∀ t ∈ xs.zip ys, P t.1 t.2`, which does not constrain lengths. So any entries of `var_0_lst` past `|c'_lst|` are known only to be `≠ none`, and they flow into `c = inv_lanes_ sh (Map Option.get! var_0_lst)`. `inv_lanes_` is `opaque`, and its only axiom, `inv_lanes__is_wf`, requires every lane to be well formed. So `wf_uN 128 c` cannot be derived. Machine-checked in SP/agents/g5-step-pure/Unprovable.lean:
- `demo_vshiftop_step` builds a real i32x4.shl step for any list `extra` of `some` lanes appended after the shifted lanes.
- `demo_Step_pure_is_wf_consequence` shows the generated statement then forces `wf_uN 128 (inv_lanes_ i32x4 (... ++ [F32 lane]))`.
- `demo_lanes_not_wf` shows that lane list is not well formed, so `inv_lanes__is_wf` does not apply.
These use only `lanes__is_wf`, `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. Since `opaque` constants are never unfolded, an interpretation of `inv_lanes_` that returns `uN.mk_uN (2^128)` on ill-formed lane lists satisfies every generated axIom and falsifies the theorem. No other axiom mentions `lanes_` or `inv_lanes_`.

PARTIAL PROOF: SP/agents/g5-step-pure/Partial.lean (with the helpers) and SP/agents/g5-step-pure/partial_proof_text.txt (replacement text starting with `:= by`). It compiles. Its only `sorry` is `have hlen : var_0_lst.length = c'_lst.length := sorry` inside the `vshiftop` case. It does not depend on any `Inhabited` default: `br_table_lt` and `vextract_lane_num` use their bounds premises through `iswf_Forall_getElem!_of_lt`, and the `binop_val` case first turns `var_0` into `some l`. It calls 14 imported operator theorems that are still `sorry` (`unop__is_wf`, `cvtop___is_wf`, `vvunop__is_wf`, `vvbinop__is_wf`, `vvternop__is_wf`, `vunop__is_wf`, `vbinop__is_wf`, `vrelop__is_wf`, `vshiftop__is_wf`, `packnum__is_wf`, `unpacknum__is_wf`, `vextunop___is_wf`, `vextbinop___is_wf`, `vcvtop___is_wf`), all with their new argument order (relation premise first). There is no scalar `binop__is_wf` in the model, so the helper `iswf_fun_binop_` covers that case.

IF THE BACKEND RESTORES THE PREMISE as the first `vshiftop` premise (its OLD position), change the alternative header to `| vshiftop c_1 v_n v_Jnn v_N vshiftop c c'_lst var_0_lst hlen hF _ hne hc hl hsh hish hn =>` and delete the `have hlen ... := sorry` line. The proof is then complete. The OLD `vbitmask` also began with a length premise; if that comes back, add one more `_` before `hci` in the `vbitmask` header.

helpers.name: iswf_Forall_singleton
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall_singleton {α : Type} {P : α → Prop} {x : α} (h : P x) : Forall P [x] :=
  iswf_Forall_cons h (iswf_Forall_nil P)
helpers.notes: Builds a Forall over a one-element list. Used throughout the (partial) Step_pure_is_wf proof. Uses no axioms.

helpers.name: iswf_Forall_cons_iff
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall_cons_iff {α : Type} {P : α → Prop} {x : α} {l : List α} :
    Forall P (x :: l) ↔ P x ∧ Forall P l :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h x (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)), fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hy))⟩,
   fun h => iswf_Forall_cons h.1 h.2⟩
helpers.notes: `simp only [iswf_Forall_cons_iff] at hall` turns the hypothesis about the concrete input list into a conjunction, one conjunct per instruction.

helpers.name: iswf_Forall_replicate
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall_replicate {α : Type} {P : α → Prop} {x : α} (n : Nat) (h : P x) :
    Forall P (List.replicate n x) :=
  fun _ hy => (List.eq_of_mem_replicate hy) ▸ h

helpers.name: iswf_admininstr_instr
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_admininstr_instr {i : instr} (h : wf_instr i) : wf_admininstr (admininstr_instr i) := by
  cases h <;> constructor <;> assumption
helpers.notes: Port of the old helper (same statement and proof). Used in the br_zero case.

helpers.name: iswf_uN_of_succ
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_uN_of_succ {v_N : Nat} {l : uN} (h : wf_uN v_N (uN.mk_uN (proj_uN_0 l + 1))) : wf_uN v_N l := by
  cases l with
  | mk_uN i => exact iswf_uN_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (iswf_uN_lt h))
helpers.notes: Replaces the old helper of the same name with a one-line proof. Used in br_succ.

helpers.name: iswf_num_I32_of_lt
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_num_I32_of_lt {i : Nat} (h : i < 2 ^ 32) :
    wf_num_ numtype.I32 (num_.mk_num__0 Inn.I32 (uN.mk_uN i)) :=
  wf_num_.num__case_0 _ _ _ (by decide) (iswf_uN_of_lt h) rfl
helpers.notes: Replaces the old iswf_I32_const and is stated at the wf_num_ level. Used for the i32 constants 0 and 1 (ref_is_null_*, vtestop_*).

helpers.name: iswf_unpack_lanetype_numtype
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_unpack_lanetype_numtype (nt : numtype) : unpack (lanetype_numtype nt) = nt := by
  cases nt <;> rfl
helpers.notes: Used in vextract_lane_num, which takes the lane through `iswf_Forall_getElem!_of_lt` and the bounds premise. Uses no axioms.

helpers.name: iswf_fun_binop_
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_fun_binop_ {nt : numtype} {op : binop_} {a b : num_} {l : List num_}
    (h : fun_binop_ nt op a b (some l)) : Forall (fun x => wf_num_ nt x) l := by
  cases h <;> first
    | exact iswf_Forall_singleton ‹_›
    | assumption
    | exact iswf_Forall_map _ _ ‹_› (fun _ h => h)
helpers.notes: Replaces the old iswf_binop and iswf_Forall_list_OMap: the model has no scalar binop__is_wf. It is stated on `some l`, so it involves neither `Option.get!` nor a default value; the `none` fallback constructor is ruled out by unification. Every fun_binop_ constructor carries the result's wf as a premise.

helpers.name: iswf_admininstr_VCONST
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_admininstr_VCONST {c : vec_} (h : wf_uN 128 c) :
    wf_admininstr (admininstr.VCONST vectype.V128 c) :=
  wf_admininstr.admininstr_case_20 _ _ (by decide) h
helpers.notes: Builds the wf of a v128 constant from `wf_uN 128`. It works because `Option.get! (size (valtype_vectype V128))` reduces to 128 by computation (no default involved).

helpers.name: iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_admininstr_VCONST_inv {c : vec_} (h : wf_admininstr (admininstr.VCONST vectype.V128 c)) :
    wf_uN 128 c := by
  cases h with | admininstr_case_20 _ _ _ hw => exact hw
helpers.notes: Inversion for a v128 constant. Needed because rcases tuple patterns do not bind names on wf_admininstr (see issues).

helpers.name: iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left {α β : Type} {R : α → β → Prop} :
    ∀ {xs : List α} {ys : List β}, xs.length = ys.length → Forall₂ R xs ys →
      ∀ x ∈ xs, ∃ y ∈ ys, R x y := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro _ _ _ _ hx; cases hx
  | cons a xs ih =>
    intro ys hlen h x hx
    cases ys with
    | nil => cases hlen
    | cons b ys =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), h (x, b) (by simp)⟩
      · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := ih (Nat.succ.inj hlen) (fun t ht => h t (by simp [ht])) x hx
        exact ⟨y, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hy), hr⟩
helpers.notes: Generic Forall₂ elimination. It needs the length equation, which is exactly the fact the regenerated vshiftop no longer supplies. Used in the vshiftop case of the partial proof, and useful to anyone hitting the same missing-length issue in other relations.

issues: Step_pure_is_wf cannot be proved as generated (the vshiftop case). The regenerated `Step_pure.vshiftop` no longer has `(List.length var_0_lst) = (List.length c'_lst)`, and the model's `Forall₂` ranges over `zip`, so it does not force equal lengths. Extra entries of `var_0_lst` (only known to be `≠ none`) reach the opaque `inv_lanes_`, whose only axiom needs every lane well formed. Machine-checked in /tmp/claude-1002/-home-zhengyew-spectec/14eafe93-c912-45da-8e28-e9b09c1a6ef6/scratchpad/agents/g5-step-pure/Unprovable.lean: a genuine i32x4.shl step exists whose result is `inv_lanes_` of the shifted lanes followed by an F32 lane. The generated statement then forces `wf_uN 128` of that, and the lane list is provably not well formed. Those demos use only lanes__is_wf, propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

The problem is systemic: the old model had 283 premises of the form `(List.length var_k_lst) = (List.length …)`; the regenerated model has 0. These are the length side conditions for the iteration variables that DefToRel introduces, and they are no longer emitted now that Sideconditions runs before DefToRel. Places in the baseline with `Forall₂` over such `var_` lists: Step_pure (vshiftop, vbitmask), fun_vunop_ (8) and fun_vunop__before_fun_vunop__case_26 (8), fun_vcvtop__ (3) and fun_vcvtop___before_fun_vcvtop___case_3 (3), fun_utf8 (3), fun_allocmodule (1). The Option.toList ones in wf_admininstr/wf_instr are harmless. Agents proving vunop__is_wf, vcvtop___is_wf, utf8 or allocmodule/instantiate theorems may hit the same wall. Possible fixes: have DefToRel emit `|var_k*| = |x*|` for the variables it introduces, re-run the iteration-length part of Sideconditions after DefToRel, or define the prelude's Forall₂ to require equal lengths.

Partial proof ready: /tmp/claude-1002/-home-zhengyew-spectec/14eafe93-c912-45da-8e28-e9b09c1a6ef6/scratchpad/agents/g5-step-pure/Partial.lean (replacement text in /tmp/claude-1002/-home-zhengyew-spectec/14eafe93-c912-45da-8e28-e9b09c1a6ef6/scratchpad/agents/g5-step-pure/partial_proof_text.txt). Every case compiles; the only gap is `have hlen : var_0_lst.length = c'_lst.length := sorry` in vshiftop. If the backend restores the premise in its old first position, bind it as `hlen` in the vshiftop alternative header and delete that line. If vbitmask's old length premise also returns, add one `_` before `hci`. Whether to merge the version with one localized sorry or keep the bare generated `sorry` is for the main session to decide.

Model behaviour worth knowing for other agents: (1) `rcases`/`obtain` tuple patterns like `⟨_, _, h⟩` on `wf_admininstr (admininstr.X …)` silently bind nothing. With 74 constructors the tuple applies to the first constructor, and the surviving case gets inaccessible names. Use `cases h with | admininstr_case_N … => …`, or `⟨⟩` plus `‹T›`. (2) Lean promoted `wf_lane_`'s lanetype argument to a parameter, so `cases` alternatives for `wf_lane_` take 6 names, not 7. (3) There is no scalar `binop__is_wf` theorem in the model; the helper `iswf_fun_binop_` covers it.
